# Lernova

> Lernova is an Android learning app with AI-led lessons, fixed practice exams with personal AI feedback, teacher-made exams from a PDF shared by code, and live rooms for instructors.

## What Lernova offers

- AI classes by grade: a weekly schedule, one topic per day, a class every 2 hours, all times in New York time.
- A full AI lesson: written explanation read aloud, quiz, results with explanations, personal feedback, questions and summary.
- Practice exams: fixed questions, 10 to 50 per exam, split evenly into easy, medium and hard; a worked explanation for every answer; personal AI analysis.
- Exams from teachers: a teacher uploads a PDF of questions, the app turns it into 4-option questions, the teacher checks the answers and sets the date, hour and duration, then shares a code. Students join with the code and the exam opens at the scheduled time.
- Teacher tools: create a named room (shown as a hashtag) with a join code; keep a day and hour schedule on the phone.
- Live rooms: guests can join with a code; public rooms can be browsed; viewers can request a turn to speak and the host admits them into one of 12 speaking seats.
- Languages: uses the device language by default; content in another language is translated automatically; English, Persian, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Turkish, Russian, Chinese and Hindi.
- AI assistant: Gemini works inside the app. ChatGPT and Claude open as separate apps with the request copied.

## Status

Grade 10 Geometry and Iran grade 9 Sets (Persian) exams are available. Voice and video calling in rooms, clickable invite links and more exam topics are coming soon.
